snippet.title: Slither Link Plus // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3935560/Slither_Link_Plus/

SlitherLink Plus — Train your brain with daily logic puzzles. Use numbers to draw one continuous loop across Square, Hex, Kite, and Cairo grids, etc, each with unique logic. Hundreds of handcrafted levels + infinite mode keep your reasoning sharp and your mind engaged.

Developed by
Vector Game
